title: Manager Security & Admin
description:
The role is integral to ensuring seamless site operations, service excellence for Job Objective our employees and visitors. You will oversee critical enablers like housekeeping, transport, guest house and site security working closely with internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Ensure 24x7 security coverage of the site with a governance SOP defined to cover including the gates, plant perimeter, employee movements, and visitor management, materials, machinery inside the premises.
* Supervise security personnel, enforce SOPs, and ensure all statutory and company security compliance protocols are met.
* Implement and review security technology infrastructure (CCTV, barriers, access control matrix and processes).
* Coordinate with local police and authorities in case of emergencies or preventive measures.
* Manage safe and timely transport for management staff, including route planning, driver supervision, and vendor performance.
* Track company transport maintenance, renewals, and fuel cost control.
* Ensure compliance with safety norms, vehicle fitness, and insurance documentation.
* Handle on-ground transport issues, emergency pick-up/drop, and grievance redressal
* Maintain high cleanliness standards across shopfloor, admin block, canteen, washrooms, and common areas.
* Supervise outsourced housekeeping staff and ensure quality audits, feedback implementation, and availability of consumables.
* Coordinate with the maintenance team for pest control, waste disposal, and hygiene upkeep.
* Introduce periodic deep-cleaning drives and visual housekeeping improvement initiatives.
* Oversee end-to-end management of guest house facilities, including bookings, housekeeping, food and hospitality standards.
* Ensure a pleasant experience for site visitors, auditors, trainees, and senior management staying at the guest house.
* Maintain records and guest feedback logs for continuous improvement
* Prepare monthly dashboards and reports for site administration KPIs and share with HR and plant leadership.
* Drive vendor governance through structured reviews, SLAs, and compliance monitoring.
* Liaise with local government authorities, utilities, and community leaders for permits, inspections, and operational support.
* Build strong relationships across departments to ensure admin services are responsive and aligned to business needs.

**Requirements**

* Communication skills, Fluency in Tamil and English language is a must
* Ability to define and drive processes that are mandatory for site’s security
* Assertiveness, ability to operate without supervision
* Crisis management
* Graduate,
* MS Office
* Over 8 years of relevant experience

title: Sr Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Description**
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.
  
  
The Sr. Support Engineer (I.C.) provides advanced technical support to customers using Gigamon solutions. This role troubleshoots complex networking issues across Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies, manages escalations through resolution, and partners with internal teams to address customer concerns. The engineer also supports RMA coordination, issue documentation, and customer satisfaction analysis. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, effective cross-functional collaboration, and a customer-focused approach to problem resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide advanced technical support to assigned customers through phone and email support queues.
* Troubleshoot, reproduce, and develop workarounds for complex product and networking issues.
* Apply strong knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, OSPF, Layer 2 and Layer 3 VPNs, multicast protocols, VLANs, trunks, switching, stacking, and service provider technologies.
* Troubleshoot GTP correlation issues and use network test equipment, including Spirent and IXIA.
* Manage hot escalations and drive customer issues through resolution while maintaining clear communication with all involved parties.
* Document and report the status of major issues, operational conditions, customer concerns, and resolution activities.
* Coordinate RMA processes, including equipment delivery to customers and the return of hardware from customer locations to Gigamon.
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Sustaining Engineering, and other internal organizations to communicate customer requirements and advocate for timely resolutions.
* Analyze and report on customer satisfaction related to Gigamon products, services, and processes.
* Participate in customer support center activities and contribute to consistent, high-quality support operations.

**What You’ve Done**

* Earned a bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field.
* Gained at least four years of technical service or technical support experience in networking.
* Built strong working knowledge across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking technologies.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting customer issues, reproducing problems, and developing effective workarounds.
* Managed technical escalations and coordinated complex issues across multiple internal teams.
* Worked directly with customers to resolve technical issues and improve customer satisfaction.
* Developed strong project management, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated the ability to document, analyze, and report on technical issues and customer feedback.

**Who You Are**

* A customer-focused technical professional who advocates for timely and effective resolutions.
* An empowered self-starter who works effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* A clear and confident communicator with strong verbal, written, and presentation skills in English.
* An active listener who builds productive relationships with customers and cross-functional teams.
* An organized professional who can prioritize responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* A collaborative partner who takes initiative, adapts to changing priorities, and works with limited supervision.

As an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, and/or local law. For more information, please refer to Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for all qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at (669) 240-2248.
  
  
If your experience and skills closely match our job description but may not necessarily fulfill all requirements, please still apply. Gigamon is on a continued mission to grow and scale an innovative organization. We believe this is best achieved by hiring, celebrating, and respecting people with diverse backgrounds, skills, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
The privacy rights of all individuals including job applicants and candidates are very important to us. Our Gigamon Applicant Privacy Policy, will inform you about how Gigamon Inc. and its direct and indirect subsidiaries collect, use, store, or otherwise process personal information about job applicants and candidates, including through your access and/or use of our careers website and third-party job websites (e.g. LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Naukri, etc.).
  
  
We may use automated tools, including AI-based systems, to help screen and evaluate application materials for this role. These tools are designed to assess job-related qualifications only and do not make final hiring decisions; human reviewers remain involved in the process. Further, Gigamon uses Jobvite, developed by Employ, to screen and evaluate all Gigamon applicant resumes. The system analyzes resumes for skills, experience, and qualifications and processes employment history, education, and skills. This AI-based system is used for all Gigamon positions. For questions, contact [email protected]. You have the right to request reasonable accommodation; to do so, please send a message to [email protected].

title: MS Engineer OSS
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a highly skilled OSS Expert with strong experience in GDC NOC Operations, Linux administration, OpenShift, and Kubernetes environments. The ideal candidate should have hands-on expertise in Nokia Cloud Platform (NCP), Nokia Cloud Operations Manager (NCOM), and NetAct/NSP/OSS products, including Fault, Configuration, and Problem Management within Enterprise Networks (Private Wireless LTE). Strong knowledge of Git & GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and production support is essential. The role also requires experience working across multi-domain network elements, ensuring system stability, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enable efficient cloud operations and seamless service delivery.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Resolution & providing technical support for the incidents reported/request Cloud products, including Nokia Cloud Platform (NCP), Nokia Cloud Operations Manager (NCOM), OSS Products (Analysis, Troubleshooting & fixing the issues reported).
* Manages technical escalations for technical requests, emergency cases and outages internally and towards customers.
* Strong hands-on experience with Linux administration, including user management, file system management, process monitoring, and system troubleshooting.
* Good knowledge of Linux shell scripting, package management, service configuration, and performance monitoring in production environments.
* Strong experience in Git & GitHub for source code management, branching strategies, and collaborative development workflows.
* Hands-on expertise in Kubernetes for container orchestration, application deployments, scaling, and monitoring.
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release management processes.
* Experience in managing and deploying applications on OpenShift platforms.
* Proficient in troubleshooting deployment issues and maintaining high availability environments.
* Ability to work closely with development and infrastructure teams for seamless delivery and operations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders like GDC, Care, Field, 3 rd PP & Customer to resolve the issues.
* Participate in CAB/CR meetings. Preparing & Validating the MoPs and executing the CRs with 100% FTR.
* Design, deploy, configure, and integrate cloud solutions independently, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
* Manage deployments and upgrades for existing customers, focusing on “right first time” execution and quick issue resolution.
* Oversee New Product Introductions (NPI) for global rollouts, driving innovation and integrating cross-product solutions.
* Provide maintenance support and operations, including defect analysis, troubleshooting, and incident resolution.
* Create and update comprehensive project documentation, including MOPs, reports, and incident RCAs.
* Ensure robust configuration management by performing regular backups, optimizing backup routines, and maintaining accurate version control across hardware and software assets.

**Key Skills And Experience**
You have:
  
  

* Require any bachelor’s degree with related field.
* Typically, a minimum 5 to 10 years of telecom experience, with 5+ years in Cloud & OSS solutions.
* Proven expertise in OCP Platform Administration and Kubernetes management.
* Experience with CI/CD tools and automation technologies (e.g., Ansible, Helm).
* Good IP networking background and scripting capabilities (Shell, PERL, Python).
* Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration.
* L3 Certified Specialist on Open Shift & NCP, MantaRay.
* Skilled in Linux administration across multiple distributions (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky, Ubuntu) and proficient in private cloud platforms such as OpenStack, VMware, Kubernetes, Nokia CBIS/NCS, RH OpenShift, NCP, and VMware Tanzu.
* Proficient in scripting and automation using Linux shell, Python, and Perl for efficient operations and process optimization.

It would be nice if you also had:
  
  

* Strong background in Networking, VNF and CNF deployment readiness, onboarding support, and automation using tools like Terraform and Ansible. Familiarity with cloud security best practice and compliance.
* Experience with containerization tools like Docker and orchestration with ECS or EKS.
* Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).

title: Senior Technical Specialist (R&D Lab)
description:
**Job Description**
 The R\&D Lab Specialist configures, designs, installs, maintains, and handles R\&D laboratory equipment and laboratory networks for the use of delivery teams. Procures, (budgets,) and integrates new products and solutions in the services laboratory. Ensures availability of laboratory equipment and maintains physical and environmental standards. Supports the integration, verification, testing, and modification of SW / HW / system components.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Responsible for all activities related to Lab Operation, IT Management, Cyber Security, Server infrastructure, and Sustainability.
* Align and standardize lab infra management world\-wide – Implementation of common tool and processes across all labs
* Cloud infra: E.g. allocate needed resources in order to support DevOps transformation \& Lab to Cloud strategy.
* Lab\-IT management: Maintaining a server, network planning, coordination with IT for new network requests/modifications, outages, firewall adaptations…
* Cybersecurity implementation, monitoring, Vulnerability Management Program in order to comply with Cyber security requirement.
* Quality adherence: ESD and calibration. TL9000, ISO45000, 14000, 27000 and BCP
* Daily Lab support to all DU’s based through Ticketing system via SLA and ad hoc interventions for problem solving
* Capex \& Opex – Budget Consolidation, Optimization
* Equipment Ordering, Shipment tracking, installation and registration.
* Lab Inventory Management, tracking utilization.
* Drive lab improvement program, innovation, tool enhancement.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 You have:
   

  

* B.E./B.Tech in relevant discipline
* 10\-12 years of experience in Networking \& Telecom domain
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (IP addressing, VLAN, routing \& switching)
* Experience in installation, configuration, and powering of network/telecom equipment
* Working knowledge of OS installation and security patch updates
* Hands\-on experience in ticket handling with understanding of SLA concepts
* Exposure to lab/network environment management including maintenance, backups, and restoration
* Good communication skills, positive attitude; CCNA or equivalent certification is an added advantage

title: Solution Owner IT Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Job Description**
 Infrastructure Subject Matter Expert (SME) will support end\-to\-end infra services in the public cloud. s part of operations, you will collaborate with architects, security teams, and end users to enhance, deploy, and support the database environment.
   

  

 EICS Public Cloud and Database Services, part of Nokia Digital Office EICS, follows a lifecycle\-based operating model that ensures end\-to\-end accountability across cloud service delivery for internal Nokia customers. Strategic planning and governance set the direction, solutions architecture translates that vision into scalable and secure designs, DevOps automation accelerates consistent delivery, and operations management maintains service reliability — all connected through a continuous feedback loop that drives ongoing improvement and ensures services consistently meet the evolving needs of internal Nokia team
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Mange the resource running in Azure, GCP, AWS and OCI, provide expert L4 administration, configuration, and troubleshooting for Linux, UNIX, and Windows servers.
* Manage and optimize enterprise VMware vSphere environments, including ESXi, vCenter, and advanced features.
* Design, implement, and manage enterprise SAN, NAS, and Object Storage solutions, administer and optimize enterprise backup and recovery systems (e.g., Azure , GCBDR or any ).
* Develop, implement, and test disaster recovery strategies to meet RTO/RPO objectives, act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure issues, leading root cause analysis.
* Drive automation initiatives using scripting (Shell, Python, PowerShell) and configuration management tools, perform advanced system performance tuning, capacity planning, and resource optimization.
* Implement and enforce security policies, ensuring compliance across all managed systems, mentor junior team members and create comprehensive documentation for systems and procedures and cloud teams, ensuring strong stakeholder communication and alignment.
* Monitor system health, troubleshooting issues, and perform root cause analysis, collaborate with DevOps, and application teams to support database needs.
* Establish best practices for database reliability, scaling, and observability


**Key Skills And Experience**
* Graduate degree with 15\+ years' experience in UNIX, Solaris, Windows, Virtualization, Storage \& Backup platforms.
* OS Admin: Expert\-level administration, configuration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, patching, and automation for Linux, UNIX, and Windows Server environments, including Active Directory.
* Virtualization: Design, implement, and manage enterprise VMware vSphere (ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX), ensuring VM lifecycle, performance, HA, and DR.
* Public Cloud: Manage resources across Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, with strong understanding of PaaS/IaaS, migration strategies, and hybrid cloud integration.
* Storage Management: Design, implement, and manage enterprise SAN/NAS/Object storage solutions (NetApp, EMC, HPE), monitoring performance and troubleshooting issues.
* Backup \& Recovery: Administer and optimize enterprise backup solutions (Azure, GCBDR, NetBackup, Rubrik), developing and testing DR strategies to meet RTO/RPO.
* Automation \& Scripting: Drive automation initiatives using Shell, Python, PowerShell, and configuration management tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
* Security \& Mentorship: Implement security policies, ensure compliance, provide L4 incident support, and mentor junior team members while maintaining documentation.

title: MS Specialist Core
description:

 Nokia Global Delivery operations comprise the NOC Operations (FCAPS) for the global telecom companies from all market segments. CSPs and Enterprise customers are served from the Nokia GDC. This Role will be responsible for end\-to\-end handling of network operations. Providing technical consultation and resolving queries/service tickets/incidents.

**Must\-Have:**
* Typically, a minimum experience on Platforms between 7\-10 yrs require

title: Security & Facilities
description:
* Monitor and control entry and exit of employees, contractors, visitors, and vehicles.
* Ensure effective gate management and verification of IDs, permits, and material movement documents.
* Conduct regular security patrols across fabrication shops, laydown areas, warehouses, jetty, and yard premises.
* Prevent theft, pilferage, trespassing, vandalism, and unauthorized activities.
* Monitor CCTV systems, access control systems, and security alarms.
* Maintain records of personnel movement, visitor passes, vehicle logs, and incident reports.
* Verify material inward and outward movement in coordination with Stores, Logistics, and Project teams.
* Support emergency response activities during fire, medical emergencies, natural calamities, and security incidents.
* Investigate security breaches and prepare incident reports with corrective actions.
* Coordinate with local authorities, police, coast guard, and emergency response agencies when required.
* Supervise contract security personnel and ensure discipline, deployment, and shift management.
* Conduct security awareness programs and toolbox talks for employees and contractors.
* Ensure compliance with company security procedures, statutory regulations, and HSE requirements.
